d: Three different women are assaulted and one of them killed. Boston police match surveillance video and witness reports to a young man that no one would ever suspect to be a killer.
Law enforcement investigates a series of unsolved murders in the state of Colorado over the course of a year.
When a young man is murdered in his home, the only suspect with a motive is his ex-girlfriend, who claims she hasn’t seen the victim for months.
The grisly murder of a grandmother in the suburbs of Cincinnati, Ohio, sends a small town police department into a fast and furious hunt for a killer.

Two women are at a major crossroads in their lives due to hoarding. Joyce's husband is ready to break up their 38-year marriage if she doesn't clean up; Kimberly is facing eviction if she doesn't address her hoard.
A pair of former punk rockers, Fuzzie and Fredd are living like teenagers well into middle age, work at a porn shop, and have stuffed their home with records and mannequins.
Tra is a 40 year-old firefighter living two separate lives. At his firehouse, he is expected to live in a clean and structured world. But in his home, he lives in chaos.
Sybil's hoard is so intense that mice have started to live in her tub and her refrigerator.
Peggy's hoard of filth and dead animal carcasses has led the city to deem her house uninhabitable.  If she does not clean up, city officials will not allow Peggy to return.
Linda's family has been ripped apart by hoarding.
Charles' house is filled with thousands of the nude paintings he has done.
Terry's fridge is packed with dead cats, and she has another 50 live ones. Her son thinks her problems stem from the time her father died of a heart attack right in front of her.

Former famed interior designer, Sandra, has hoarded out every square inch of the historic mansion she lost to foreclosure. She refuses to leave the manor in spite of the fact the bank has sold it to a new couple.
Shanna owns the worst hoard in “Hoarders” history — a house crammed floor to ceiling with bottles filled with human waste.
Ruby, aka Big Momma's house, is so hoarded she spends her entire day living in the car, and her grandson has started running the streets of LA.
After the death of her newborn son, Chris filled the void by surrounding herself with possessions.
Roxann is a former model who has successfully hidden her hoarding until now. Barbara's extreme hoarding has forced her out of her house.
Ronald is a firefighter who is legally mandated to report hoarded homes. But in this case, the hoarder is his wife, Eileen, and the house is his own.
